item.title: The VinePair Podcast: Where Does Vermouth Go Next?
item.description: The vermouth category is full of legacy brands with hundreds of years of history that cater to in-the-know consumers. What the sector largely lacks is a fun, modern vermouth company that invites newcomers to try the fortified wine. David Neimanis and Phi Peinado spotted that void in the market, prompting them to move from the U.S. to Spain and start Cueva Nueva. item.description: Bordeaux is one of the world’s most famous wine regions, with drinkers the world over infatuated with its juicy red blends, crisp whites, and supple dessert wines. item.title: Good Vibes From a Bad Decade: A Look at NYC’s ’70s-Inspired Bars
item.description: The retro 1970s-style bar is having a moment. The simplest reason why may be because the 1970s, while they may still feel fresh to people of a certain age, happened half a century ago. This makes the decade overripe for nostalgia, and nostalgia is fun. item.description: Tilray Brands, Inc. acquired BrewDog for £33 million, or $44 million, a sum representing a massive drop from the Scottish craft brewery’s peak $2.7 billion valuation.
